page.overview:
Who is Kehan Dadi?

When Sun Wukong made a request to the Jade Emperor to identify the true identity of the Single Horned Rhinoceros King, Kehan Dadi and his bureau were dispatched to perform a survey of Heaven and the stars. They were unable to identify anyone missing from their post.
